LanguageData.RR_SS_setting_doPowerPreregs_tooltip: Ensures powered buildings require electricity to invent.
LanguageData.RR_SS_setting_doSurgeryPreregs_tooltip: Ensures installation of natural and artificial bodyparts requires an appropriate understanding of medicine and prosthetics. For example, installing a peg leg only requires knowledge of form-fitting clothing, while installing a bionic leg requires solid knowledge of basic prosthetics and anti-rejection drugs.
LanguageData.RR_SS_setting_doSurgeryPreregs_option_Ea:
Assign prerequisites of neolithic projects.
Projects involved:

 Simple apparel
 Medicinal herbs
LanguageData.RR_SS_setting_doSurgeryPreregs_option_No:
Assign prerequisites of medieval and early game industrial projects.
Projects involved:

 Simple apparel
 Complex clothing
 Prosthetics
 Penoxycyline
LanguageData.RR_settings_restartWarning: Restarting the game is required for the above to apply.
